name: 27103 · Winston Salem, NC
findings: ZIP 27103 (Winston Salem) has 199 nonprofit organizations. 72 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 58 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 27103 (Winston Salem) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
